C0002 has only one significant RNA pathway (EMT) and no significant WXS or CNV findings. Cross-modal consistency is weak with low patient support. No positive structural evidence supports split or merge. The evidence is too limited to define a coherent biological identity, and no available extra evidence can resolve this. Dropping is better supported than accepting.

C0003 has no significant biological enrichment in any modality after FDR correction. Cross-modal consistency is weak, and technical confounders are not significant. No positive structural evidence supports split or merge. The candidate lacks a defensible molecular identity, so dropping is better supported than accepting.

C0004 has coherent biological support from RNA (multiple significant pathways) and CNV (significant copy-number losses on chr7 and 20), with a nominal PBRM1 mutation trend. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI and RNA silhouettes. Technical confounders are not significantly enriched at set level. No positive structural evidence supports split or merge. Retaining for downstream validation is better supported than dropping.

No positive structural evidence supports split or merge. Dropping is better supported than accepting.
